archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Purple/Orange Brand)

layout.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border bg-white flex flex-col
layout.header: h-16 border-b border-border bg-white flex items-center px-6 justify-between

components.kpi_card: bg-white p-6 border border-border flex flex-col gap-2 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer
components.tab_item: px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold border-b-2 border-transparent text-[#4B5563] hover:text-[#6B21A8] transition-colors data-[state=active]:border-[#6B21A8] data-[state=active]:text-[#6B21A8]
components.modal: fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-6
components.modal_content: bg-white p-8 border border-border/20 shadow-2xl max-w-5xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto relative
components.chart_container: bg-white p-6 border border-border min-h-[350px] flex flex-col gap-4 shadow-sm

structure.atoms: Basic UI elements (Buttons, Inputs, Typography, Material Icons, Badges)
structure.molecules: Combinations of atoms (Form Fields, KPI Cards, Tab Items, Alert Badges)
structure.organisms: Complex UI sections (Sidebar, Header, Chart Widgets, ML Form, Data Tables, Modals)
structure.pages: Complete views with connected data (Main Dashboard App, Tabs Content)

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT ATOMIC DESIGN STRICTLY: Create folders for atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, and pages inside src/components.
Use @mui/icons-material for all icons. Do not use lucide-react. The user explicitly requested Material-UI icons.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the UI.
Apply the Purple (#6B21A8) as primary and Orange (#E67E22) as secondary brand colors as requested.
Alert colors must be mapped EXACTLY to: ALTA = #C0392B, MEDIA = #E67E22, BAJA = #2980B9. Do not alter these.
Headings MUST use 'Manrope' font, body uses 'IBM Plex Sans'. NEVER use Inter for headings.
Integrate Recharts for all data visualization. Ensure tooltips and axes use the body font and follow the high-contrast color scheme.
When a user clicks on a specific chart or KPI card, open a Modal (Organism) showing a detailed expanded view of that data.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='tab-traffic').
Keep the background light (#F9FAFB) and surfaces white (#FFFFFF) for high contrast and readability. Do not implement dark mode.
Ensure the ML model tab includes a visual representation of a decision tree, confusion matrix, classification report, and an interactive prediction form.
